Project Cloud Lowy Sneakers

Previous page
Next page
Previous page
Next page

Step into all-season comfort with the Lowy Sneakers. Textile and genuine leather upper, SmartFoam memory foam insole, and a water-resistant finish. Non-slip outsole and durable strong stitching keep you comfortable through every walk, errand, and busy season.

  • Are the Lowy Sneakers true to size?

    The Lowy Sneakers fit true to size. If you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up for the best comfort. The textile and leather upper adapts to your foot shape over time for a personalized fit.

  • Do the Lowy Sneakers have memory foam?

    Yes! The Lowy Sneakers feature our SmartFoam memory foam insole that delivers cushioned support that lasts. Perfect for all-day wear, whether at work, running errands, or out for the day.

  • Are the Lowy Sneakers water-resistant?

    Yes! The Lowy Sneakers are designed with a water-resistant finish, making them dependable shoes for different occasions and unpredictable weather. Stay comfortable and dry through every season.

  • What material is the Lowy Sneaker upper made of?

    The Lowy Sneakers feature a textile and genuine leather upper that blends durability and comfort. Durable strong stitching reinforces every seam, ensuring these sneakers hold up beautifully through daily wear.

  • Are the Lowy Sneakers good for walking?

    Absolutely. The Lowy Sneakers are built for extended wear with a SmartFoam memory foam insole that cushions every step and a non-slip outsole for reliable traction on a wide variety of surfaces.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.
